scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Strawberry Vikas Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to one of the specified districts: Gopalganj, Jehanabad, Lakhisarai, Saran, Supaul, Aurangabad, Begusarai, Bhagalpur, Gaya, Katihar, Kishanganj, Munger, Muzaffarpur, Nalanda, West Champaran, Patna, East Champaran, Purniyan, Samastipur, Vaishali
Applicant must have agricultural land between 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and 5 acres (2 ha)
Applicant must be registered on the DBT portal
Benefits can be taken by ryot farmers based on land documents and by non-ryot farmers based on a contract form
Beneficiaries will be selected on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹3,36,000 per hectare subsidy for strawberry farming and a 40% subsidy on packaging materials (wooden and plastic boxes) along with quality seedlings.
